name: the-ai-panel-hint-wears-the-sidebar-hint-s-accent
description: the hover hints the AI panel raises over its action row are built in the panel's own document, where the sidebar's hints go native to HintOverlayWidget's /hint document instead. This run raises one of each and reads the tokens and the box off both cards, so a difference in accent, surface, radius or shadow between the two shows up as a value rather than as an impression.

actions.note: the container widens before the card's own layout settles

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-ai-panel-quick="bullets"]'); b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerover', {bubbles: true})); return 'sent'; })()

actions.note: the hover hint's own 600ms delay, on the real clock

actions.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.hint'); if (!el) { return 'no hint'; } const s = getComputedStyle(el); return [s.backgroundColor, s.borderRadius, s.boxShadow, s.fontFamily.split(',')[0]].join(' | '); })()
actions.note: the paper carries the accent at 6% through overlay.css's color-mix, so one string covers surface and accent together
overlay.css writes this token as rgb(176 58 72); the hex is PushOverlayTheme's own value, so reading it back proves the push lands on this document and a later one repaints it

actions.expression: (() => { const q = document.querySelector('[data-ai-panel-quick="bullets"]'); q.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerout', {bubbles: true})); const b = document.querySelector('.aippin'); if (!b) { return 'no-button'; } b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerover', {bubbles: true})); return 'sent'; })()
actions.note: the header buttons were outside the hover allowlist, and parkTitlesUnder had already taken their title, so hovering one showed nothing at all

actions.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.hint .hint-text'); return el ? el.textContent : 'no hint'; })()

assertions.desc: setup: the hotkey opened the panel
setup: an action button was hovered
setup: a sidebar nav button was hovered

A header button raises a hint at all - it used to raise none, and had no tooltip left either
And it wears the same card as the action row's
The panel's bubble is the shared card plus the hint pill
the sidebar's bubble carries the same classes
The theme push reaches the panel document, so a change repaints the bubble in place
